Help

Questions, answered.

Quick reads on orders, shipping, returns, garment care and accounts. Can't find your answer? Write to hello@shanky.in — a real human replies.

Most orders leave the atelier within 24–48 hours. You'll receive a tracking link by email the moment your parcel goes on its way.

You can edit address or cancel within 30 minutes of placing the order, from your account page. After that, write to us — we'll do our best.

Check the spam folder first. Still nothing? Email hello@shanky.in with the email you ordered with — we'll resend.
